snapshot: At 11:00 JST the Nikkei was 65,609.59, up 613.50. After briefly moving above 66,000 just after the open, the index gave back part of the early surge.
Prime-market breadth at 11:00 JST was 662 gainers, 840 decliners and 60 unchanged, so the internal tape is much less bullish than the index level suggests.
Nikkei 225 night-session futures closed at 65,510. Cash opened at 65,777.87, initially exceeding the overnight futures level.
Reuters reported the Nikkei near record territory on AI optimism, Brent near $99, WTI at $93.05 and USD/JPY in the low 159s. U.S.-Iran talks remain unstable.
The morning leadership is concentrated in large semiconductor and chemical names such as Advantest, Tokyo Electron and Shin-Etsu, with buying also spreading into materials names such as Daito Chemix.

drivers.driver: U.S. AI optimism and semiconductor buying
drivers.why_today: AI optimism in U.S. markets carried into Tokyo, with Advantest and Tokyo Electron contributing heavily to the Nikkei's rise. Semiconductors are the main driver of the index move.

drivers.driver: Oil and FX remain unstable while markets wait for Iran talks
drivers.why_today: Brent is still near $100 and USD/JPY is in the low 159s. Risk appetite is alive, but oil and intervention risk still limit broad participation.

drivers.driver: Buying is spreading from semiconductor leaders into materials and return stories
drivers.why_today: Alongside index-heavy chip names, investors are also rotating into easy-to-understand catalysts such as Daito Chemix's photoresist materials and Tesec's buyback.

deep_dive.title: Advantest: test whether the index leader can keep driving the AI-semiconductor tape

lines: Among large caps, Advantest is the key leadership stock today. It is the biggest positive Nikkei contributor after the U.S. semiconductor rally and continued AI capex optimism.
The index is higher, but decliners outnumber gainers. That means Advantest's ability to hold strength is an important test of whether the index rally is durable.
At 11:00 JST, Advantest added 324.63 yen to the Nikkei, making it the largest positive contributor.
U.S. AI optimism pushed equities higher, and Tokyo is seeing broad buying in semiconductor equipment stocks.
Can it hold the 27,000-yen area and remain one of the top positive Nikkei contributors into the afternoon.
Does the move keep spreading into Tokyo Electron, KOKUSAI and Tesec.
U.S. futures or SOX-related expectations weaken and major semiconductor names all stall.
The index gain becomes too concentrated in Advantest and a few high-priced names, exposing the weak internal tape.
Because the stock's index impact is large, a futures-led sell program can quickly create mechanical profit-taking.
Disappointment around Middle East talks or renewed intervention concern in USD/JPY near 159 can reduce afternoon risk appetite.
